# P.E.N. open analog catalog

Every 6 km Earth window searched by P.E.N. (10,424 windows in 14 regions), with its similarity score to each of the 9 Moon and Mars targets and Earth context layers (temperature, mineralogy). Method: `docs/METHOD.md`. Code: `scripts/release_catalog.py`.

## Files

| File | Size | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `pen_analog_catalog.csv` | 4.4 MB | one row per window (wide table, columns below) |
| `pen_analog_catalog.geojson` | 9.1 MB | the windows as WGS84 polygons (RFC 7946 GeoJSON) with `window_id`, `region`, `combined__*` and `rank__*`; join the CSV by `window_id` for every other column |
| `pen_top_windows.csv` | 18 kB | top 20 windows per target with the 95 % bootstrap CI of score and rank |
| `SHA256SUMS` | | checksums of the files above (`shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS`) |

A GeoJSON with every column on the polygons (`pen_analog_catalog_full.geojson`) is generated in `data/release_full/` (not in the repository, because of its size) and is published with the Zenodo deposit of the release.

Join the polygons with all columns (Python, geopandas):

```python
gdf = gpd.read_file("pen_analog_catalog.geojson")
gdf = gdf.merge(pd.read_csv("pen_analog_catalog.csv").drop(columns=[c for c in gdf.columns if c != "window_id"], errors="ignore"), on="window_id")
```

## How to use it (read this first)

- Say **"top window" with its confidence interval, never "the best place"**. Under bootstrap resampling of the reference terrain the rank of a target's #1 window can move as far as #176 (`pen_top_windows.csv`).
- **Mars does not separate**: for the Mars targets the score does not rank known Mars analog sites above other windows (AUC 0.33–0.50); flat plains score high for Arcadia Planitia (flat-plains degeneracy). Use Mars scores as terrain similarity only.
- Scores compare **terrain and low-Sun shadowing only**. They say nothing about temperature, gravity, vacuum, radiation or chemistry. Temperature (MODIS) and mineralogy (EMIT) columns are context and are **not** part of any score.
- Scores of different targets are not fully comparable; use `rank__<target>` to compare a window across targets.
- Coverage: LST is available for 10,417 of 10,424 windows; EMIT observed 6,846 windows in 9 regions (elsewhere `emit_coverage_frac` is 0 and the share columns are empty). EMIT shares are shares of detections, not mineral abundances, and iron oxides are a lower bound.

## Columns

`<target>` is one of: `moon_connecting_ridge`, `moon_nobile_rim1`, `moon_de_gerlache_rim`, `moon_malapert`, `moon_haworth`, `moon_leibnitz_beta`, `mars_arcadia`, `mars_jezero`, `mars_deuteronilus`.

| Column | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `window_id` | text | window id `<region>_<i>_<j>` (same id as the web app) |
| `region` | text | Earth region id (config/sites.yaml) |
| `region_label` | text | Earth region name |
| `i, j` | pixel | row and column of the window's top-left corner on the region's 30 m grid (6 km windows, 3 km step) |
| `lon, lat` | degrees (WGS84) | window centre |
| `relief` | log10(m) | local relief: log10 of the P98 − P2 elevation range in the window |
| `slope_med` | degrees | median slope |
| `slope_p90` | degrees | 90th-percentile slope |
| `rough` | log10(m) | 150 m roughness: log10 of the RMS deviation from a 5×5-pixel (150 m) moving mean |
| `hypso` | 0–1 | hypsometry: (mean − P2) / (P98 − P2) elevation |
| `shadow_e2` | 0–1 | mean cast-shadow fraction at 2° Sun elevation over 8 azimuths |
| `shadow_e5` | 0–1 | mean cast-shadow fraction at 5° Sun elevation over 8 azimuths |
| `combined__moon_connecting_ridge` | 0–100 | combined score (all 7 features) against Moon · Shackleton Connecting Ridge (LOLA Site01) |
| `terrain__moon_connecting_ridge` | 0–100 | terrain score (5 terrain features) against Moon · Shackleton Connecting Ridge (LOLA Site01) |
| `illumination__moon_connecting_ridge` | 0–100 | illumination score (2 shadow features) against Moon · Shackleton Connecting Ridge (LOLA Site01) |
| `rank__moon_connecting_ridge` | 1…N | position of the window among all windows by combined score against Moon · Shackleton Connecting Ridge (LOLA Site01) (1 = top; ties in file order) |
| `combined__moon_nobile_rim1` | 0–100 | combined score (all 7 features) against Moon · Nobile Rim 1 (LOLA Site06, Artemis candidate region) |
| `terrain__moon_nobile_rim1` | 0–100 | terrain score (5 terrain features) against Moon · Nobile Rim 1 (LOLA Site06, Artemis candidate region) |
| `illumination__moon_nobile_rim1` | 0–100 | illumination score (2 shadow features) against Moon · Nobile Rim 1 (LOLA Site06, Artemis candidate region) |
| `rank__moon_nobile_rim1` | 1…N | position of the window among all windows by combined score against Moon · Nobile Rim 1 (LOLA Site06, Artemis candidate region) (1 = top; ties in file order) |
| `combined__moon_de_gerlache_rim` | 0–100 | combined score (all 7 features) against Moon · de Gerlache Rim (LOLA Site11) |

| `lst_mean_K` | K | MODIS MOD11A2 land-surface temperature: per pixel, mean of all valid day and night 8-day composites of 2025; window mean over valid pixels (context, not scored) |
| `lst_min_K` | K | MODIS MOD11A2 land-surface temperature: per pixel, 5th percentile of the night composites; window mean (context, not scored) |
| `lst_max_K` | K | MODIS MOD11A2 land-surface temperature: per pixel, 95th percentile of the day composites; window mean (context, not scored) |
| `lst_range_K` | K | MODIS MOD11A2 land-surface temperature: per pixel, max − min; window mean (context, not scored) |
| `n_valid_day` | count | MODIS MOD11A2 land-surface temperature: valid day composites per pixel (max 46), window mean (context, not scored) |
| `n_valid_night` | count | MODIS MOD11A2 land-surface temperature: valid night composites per pixel (max 46), window mean (context, not scored) |
| `emit_coverage_frac` | 0–1 | NASA EMIT L2B: share of the window's 60 m cells with at least one valid EMIT observation (0 = not observed) (context, not scored) |
| `emit_n_granules` | count | NASA EMIT L2B: EMIT granules contributing at least one valid observation to the window (context, not scored) |
| `emit_frac_clays` | 0–1 | NASA EMIT L2B: EMIT-10 weighted share of valid observations assigned to clays (context, not scored; a share, not an abundance) |
| `emit_frac_carbonates` | 0–1 | NASA EMIT L2B: EMIT-10 weighted share of valid observations assigned to carbonates (context, not scored; a share, not an abundance) |
| `emit_frac_iron_oxides` | 0–1 | NASA EMIT L2B: EMIT-10 weighted share of valid observations assigned to iron oxides (lower bound: mineral IDs without EMIT-10 weights are unmapped) (context, not scored; a share, not an abundance) |
| `emit_frac_sulfates` | 0–1 | NASA EMIT L2B: EMIT-10 weighted share of valid observations assigned to sulfates (context, not scored; a share, not an abundance) |
| `emit_frac_present_unweighted_clays` | 0–1 | NASA EMIT L2B: share of observations where the EMIT-10 matrix marks clays as present with unknown weight (−1) (context, not scored; a share, not an abundance) |
| `emit_frac_present_unweighted_carbonates` | 0–1 | NASA EMIT L2B: share of observations where the EMIT-10 matrix marks carbonates as present with unknown weight (−1) (context, not scored; a share, not an abundance) |
| `emit_frac_present_unweighted_iron_oxides` | 0–1 | NASA EMIT L2B: share of observations where the EMIT-10 matrix marks iron oxides as present with unknown weight (−1) (context, not scored; a share, not an abundance) |
| `emit_frac_present_unweighted_sulfates` | 0–1 | NASA EMIT L2B: share of observations where the EMIT-10 matrix marks sulfates as present with unknown weight (−1) (context, not scored; a share, not an abundance) |
| `emit_frac_unmapped_g1` | 0–1 | NASA EMIT L2B: share of group-1 detections with no EMIT-10 weight (context, not scored; a share, not an abundance) |
| `emit_frac_unmapped_g2` | 0–1 | NASA EMIT L2B: share of group-2 detections with no EMIT-10 weight (context, not scored; a share, not an abundance) |
| `emit_frac_no_detection` | 0–1 | NASA EMIT L2B: share of valid observations with no mineral detection (context, not scored; a share, not an abundance) |

`pen_top_windows.csv`: `target`, `rank` (1–20, equal weights), `window_id`, `region`, `score` (0–100), `score_ci95_low`, `score_ci95_high`, `rank_ci95_low`, `rank_ci95_high`, `n_ref` (reference windows resampled).

Empty cells mean no data (for example no valid LST composites, or no EMIT observation).
